messages:
Samira Patel: Hey team — first day! My MacBook Pro (M2, macOS 14.2) is connected to the USB-C dock but the external monitor isn’t being detected. Dock lights on, laptop charges, but Display settings only show the laptop screen. Any quick troubleshooting steps? Also the monitor I was expecting still shows as 'in transit' in the tracker — who should I follow up with for ETA? Thanks :wave:

Mike (IT): Welcome Samira! Quick Qs — are you using the company-supplied USB-C cable that came with the dock? Also can you paste output of:```system_profiler SPDisplaysDataType```or for a quick check run:```Apple menu > About This Mac > Displays```

Samira Patel: I used the cable that came in the box. Running system_profiler now, paste below if useful:`"Display VendorID: 610"` — not sure what that means.

Ashley - People Ops: @Samira Patel :wave: welcome aboard! Logistics pinged me earlier — shipment-bot should have the latest, but Sam (Logistics) can confirm ETA. If it's urgent we can drop a spare monitor from the office to you.

shipment-bot: Shipment update for package #RDW-449271: status=In transit, last_scan=2025-11-02 09:18 UTC, carrier=FastShip, est_delivery=2025-11-04 (subject to carrier).

Sam - Logistics: Hey @Samira — looking at the tracking, looks like it's delayed one scan. I can request an expedited reroute if you need the physical monitor today — do you need it delivered to the office or your home?

Samira Patel: Office please (SF HQ). If office spare is available that would be great — would make setup faster. Thanks!

Mike (IT): For the dock issue, try unplugging the HDMI/DP on the dock, reboot the dock (unplug power for 10s), reconnect dock to laptop. Also check System Settings > Displays > Hold Option and click "Detect Displays". If still no luck, run:`ioreg -lw0 | grep -i "DisplayVendorID"` and paste output.

Jordan (Network): Not likely network-related but FYI some dock firmwares block MST until updated. Mike, do we have a payload to push to MDM to update dock firmware remotely?

Mike (IT): We don't push dock firmware via MDM, but we have a spare updated hub in the IT closet on 4th floor. @Samira — if you can swing by IT (drop by desk 4B) I can swap it in 5 minutes. Otherwise Sam (Logistics) will try to reroute the office spare.

Sam - Logistics: I'll ping the courier and mark as high priority. ETA to SF HQ if rerouted: same-day pickup window, should arrive by 18:00 PT. Will update here.

Samira Patel: Perfect — I'll head to IT now, thanks everyone! :smile:
